revenue.source: COST 10-K filings via financial_statements: FY2024/FY2025 acc. 0000909832-25-000101, FY2026 acc. 0000909832-26-000093, USD millions

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 growth was 10.1% and FY2025 8.2%; fade from 8% toward ~5.5% as scale grows (comparable sales plus new warehouses).

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2026 margin 3.85% (11,685/303,154), up from 3.65% FY2024 and 3.77% FY2025; hold ~3.9%.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2026 effective rate ~24.7% (1 - net income 9,226 / pretax 12,251, acc. 0000909832-26-000093); rounded to 25%.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y par, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta ~0.85 (Damodaran Retail Grocery & Food unlevered cash-corrected 0.848; Costco D/E ~0) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = ~8.65%; debt weight negligible, so WACC ~8.6%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: lowered from 3.0% to 2.5% to be more conservative and reduce reliance on terminal value (flagged >75% of EV); roughly long-run inflation plus modest real growth, well below the 4.86% risk-free rate. A 5-year explicit horizon for a growing retailer inherently leaves a high terminal share.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 6,162 (LTD noncurrent 3,914 + current 2,248) - cash 20,207 - short-term investments 1,094; acc. 0000909832-26-000093; USD millions

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares 444,427,000, acc. 0000909832-26-000093; in millions
